owner: Existing Content Lab SQLite/repo_context; optional pure sibling repo_manifest.py
batch_id_algorithm: existing automation_core.digest(binding); use actual helper serialization, not compact JSONL serialization
jsonl_policy: UTF8, sorted keys, compact comma/colon separators, allow_nan=False, one LF per row
offset_semantics: Half-open byte intervals; empty file represented by one zero-length chunk; no UTF16/character offsets.
precondition: all indexed range/hash/revision proof must pass before verified publication

artifacts.REPO_MANIFEST.jsonl: All entries, including gaps. No unbounded per-file part ID array.
artifacts.PARTS_INDEX.jsonl: Every INDEXED captured chunk with immutable byte range/hash.
artifacts.VALIDATION.json: Streaming reconstruction/index proof; PASS only after actual verification.

proof_scopes.native_info: Global byte proof NOT_RUN unless actually executed.
proof_scopes.native_part_page: Returned chunk rows only, if verified.
proof_scopes.cli_validation: Full indexed-byte reconstruction in one consistent read view.

failure_rules: Orphan/non-indexed raw chunks and corrupted ranges/revisions reject verified publication.
Output staged until proof passes; no success on interrupt/disk-full.
Existing damaged output never silently overwritten as verified.
Protected/excluded bytes are never added as part payload.

native.scope: repository/snapshot/profile; PARTS fileOrdinal is part of query identity
native.pagination: offset relative to query scope, nextOffset only after emitted rows; row overflow explicit, never skipped
native.response: occ.native-durable-result.v1 + manifest binding/scope/total/rows/nextOffset/proof_scope; raw chunk bytes not included

writer_cli.profile: Existing trusted operator profile; UI cannot override root/store/output argv.
writer_cli.output: Operator-selected directory outside source repo, whole-directory staged publish after PASS; actual handler not implemented in this package.

git_blob_oid_verifier: Stream hash of b"blob "+ascii(size)+b"\0"+captured bytes, SHA1 for 40-hex OID or SHA256 for 64-hex OID; compare to original stored git_oid without Git calls.
